messages:
alina: heads-up: launching model-route v2 tonight at 23:00 UTC. want to use a quantile-based FF ramp (route_latency_quantile) + regional phased rollout.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by @alina at 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC. runbook: /runbooks/model-route-v2-rollout (link).

kai: agree on quantile-slicing. last rollout with pure percentage bumped tail p99. we'll route the fastest requests first.

noah: proposed rollout plan: 
- Canary (region us-west): quantile 0-10 (~1% traffic) soak 10m
- Stage A (multi-region): quantile 0-30 (~5%) soak 20m
- Stage B: quantile 0-60 (~25%) soak 30m
- Full: open to 100% after checks and regional success
Also receptor: if us-west OK, promote us-east then eu.

dina: instrumentation notes: edge adds header `X-rt-quantile` derived from rolling 1m histogram on edge.latency_ms. use that for routing decisions. make sure we don't drift quantile boundaries under load.

sre-oncall: safety thresholds to enforce: 
- p99 delta > +200ms for 5m => fast-disable
- 5m error-rate increase > 0.4 percentage points => disable
- sustained queue depth > 1500 => fallback
Alerts page to #eng-oncall + PD.

kai: what's the immediate disable command? give exact CLI.

alina: fast actions in runbook: 
```
# disable routing flag globally
rbctl feature-flag set route_latency_quantile.enabled false --reason "safety"
# pin old route binary if needed
rbctl deploy promote route-service --tag route-v1 --note "rollback"
```
Or via ops-bot: `/ops ff off route_latency_quantile` (adds audit entry).

ops-bot: note: `/ops ff off route_latency_quantile --urgent` will also notify PD and attach runbook link.

noah: telemetry queries to watch: 
- p99: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(edge_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))`
- error-rate: `sum(rate(route_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(route_requests_total[5m]))`
- regional qps: `sum(rate(route_requests_total{region=~".*"}[1m])) by (region)`

dina: we'll pin the feature flag to the exact binary and release id during rollout: `rbctl ff set route_latency_quantile.version "v2.0.7-20260321" --sticky` so autoscaling or autosync doesn't swap code mid-rollout.

alina: schedule: start 23:00 UTC, canary 10m, then stage A 20m, stage B 30m. roll order: us-west -> us-east -> eu. we'll do a smoke check at the 10m and 20m boundaries.

sre-oncall: add automatic circuit-breaker rule in pipeline: if CPU>80% for 3m OR p95 latency > baseline + 300ms -> auto-fallback to route-v1 and disable flag. tie into deploy pipeline for immediate action.

kai: i'll be monitoring dashboards (console/dashboards/model-route-v2). i'll post short status updates after each phase.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @alina at 1719980000

deploy-bot: Canary enabled -> `route_latency_quantile` routing quantile 0-10 in us-west (~1% traffic)

ops-bot: reaction :thumbsup: (x2)

sre-oncall: temporary alerts enabled: MRV2_P99_Regression, MRV2_Error_Surge -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

dina: reminder: toggle is version-scoped. to pin during canary: `rbctl ff set route_latency_quantile.meta version=v2.0.7-20260321`

kai: oncall for first 40m; ping me immediately on alerts. i'll call rollback if any threshold hits.

noah: quick check-in: canary p50/p95 stable, p99 +40ms so far. continuing to stage after 12m.

alina: promoting to stage A (quantile 0-30) now. will wait 20m soak.

deploy-bot: Stage A enabled -> quantile 0-30 across us-west/us-east (~5% traffic)

ops-bot: reaction :rocket:

sre-oncall: monitoring... no alerts yet. keep an eye on queue depth.

kai: stage A looks fine at +12m. moving to stage B after soak.

alina: promoting Stage B (quantile 0-60). pinned version confirmed.

deploy-bot: Stage B enabled -> quantile 0-60 (~25% traffic)

sre-oncall: standing by. thresholds unchanged.

kai: noah and i will stay for the next 30m. if p99 delta exceeds +220ms sustained 5m we disable.

noah: all green; increasing to 100% in 10m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Full open: `route_latency_quantile` now routing 100% (quantile algorithm disabled)

alina: release notes to post: "model-route v2 deployed with quantile-based ramp (pinned v2.0.7-20260321). staged rollout us-west -> us-east -> eu. rollback thresholds and circuit-breakers enabled."

ops-bot: reminder: you can view audit trail at /audit/flags/route_latency_quantile

kai: closing: great job team. will file a short postmortem if any anomalies show up overnight. ttyl."
